props.description:
Deal Physical damage to one creature.

The Asura's blades carry whatever element last bit it, striking harder and leaving a mark:

  • Bolt — the target is left Paralyzed.

  • Fire — the strike gains Overflow.

  • Ice — the target is left Disarmed.

  • Air — the target is left Silenced.
props.name: Elemental Slash

props.study_text: Not a demon — a demi-god, and it will say so between blows. It wanders looking for a fight worth losing and has never found one. Every element it has ever tasted stays with it: strike it with fire and it remembers fire, and in this valley it remembers lightning even when nobody swung. When it has gathered all four, step back.
